'''Koedi Raef''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]], on which she discovered a hidden data packet from the [[R2z Starship Maintenance Droid]] [[R2z-DL]]. It contained information relating to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence in the [[Lifh sector/Legends|Lifh sector]] and on the [[Vilosorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Using this data, Raef was able to facilitate the [[Liberation of Vilosoria|liberation]] of [[Vilosoria]].
